source.text:
Location: Seattle, WA

Remote: Yes (US Pacific time, available evenings/weekends too)

Willing to relocate: No

Technologies: Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Node, FastAPI, React/Next.js, Postgres/SQLite, Stripe API + webhooks, Solana RPC/websockets (read-only alerts), Playwright/requests scrapers, Google Sheets/Slack/Telegram/Discord APIs, local LLMs (Ollama/qwen), Swift/iOS (side projects)

Résumé/CV: https://github.com/AugustusTheGuy

Email: builtxbyxbear@gmail.com

Solo dev who ships small automations fast, often the same day. Fixed-price work I do regularly:

- Website -> CSV/Sheets export script, free 20-row sample first ($297)

- Stripe payment -> Google Sheet + Slack/email alerts ($397)

- Solana wallet watch -> Telegram/Discord alerts, read-only, no keys ($449)

I also take hourly or contract work on Python/TS backends, integrations and internal tools.
